result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a clear vertical alignment defect: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is shifted ~30px lower than its neighbors, breaking the row's baseline grid. A couple of smaller consistency issues appear in card metadata and the favorite (heart) button treatment.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row the cards are not vertically aligned. The first (Green Bowl Poké) and third (Trattoria Piccol…) cards start at the same top edge, while the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) sits roughly 30px lower, so its image, ETA badge, title and delivery-fee line all fall out of line with the adjacent cards. This makes the row look broken/jittery rather than intentionally staggered.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a shared top alignment and fixed image height/aspect ratio (e.g. align-items: flex-start on the row, uniform image container height) so titles, badges and fee text share consistent baselines across cards.

issues.description: The favorite/heart control is rendered inconsistently between the two 'Popular right now' cards: on the ramen card it appears as a bare white outline glyph, while on the pizza card it sits inside a visible dark circular button. The same control should not change container treatment from card to card.
issues.suggestion: Apply one consistent heart-button style (e.g. always a semi-transparent dark circular scrim behind the icon) so it has predictable affordance and guaranteed contrast on any photo.

issues.description: Metadata density is inconsistent between sections: 'Popular right now' cards show rating, ETA, delivery fee and cuisine, while 'Fastest near you' cards show only name and delivery fee (no rating or cuisine tag), leaving noticeably empty space under those titles.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the card metadata template across sections, or add a rating/cuisine line to the 'Fastest near you' cards so the rows feel visually balanced and equally informative.
